row.evidence: TeamViewer's SCIM guides for Entra ID and Okta require a valid Tensor licence, and the pricing page lists Tensor as a fully customized enterprise licence with SSO (contact sales).
row.notes: Status unchanged (gated, Tensor). Prices changed since June: Premium $120.90/mo (was $112.90) and Corporate $245.90/mo (was $229.90), billed yearly excl. tax; Remote Access $24.90 and Business $50.90 unchanged. Team plan changed from Business to Premium because Business and Remote Access include 1 licensed user; Premium includes 15. Pricing is flat per licence, so per-user fields are null. SCIM base URL https://webapi.teamviewer.com/scim/v2 with a script token; Entra guide says SCIM cannot delete users (deactivate only). Web API is on Business, Premium, Corporate and Tensor. June's ADFS/OneLogin SCIM claim: TeamViewer documents SCIM only for Entra ID and Okta (SSO for OneLogin/ADFS), so that part was dropped.

auth.token_source: TeamViewer web app > Admin settings > Apps and token > Create script token (user management and user group permissions)

endpoints.notes: No SCIM API reference is published; endpoints inferred only from documented user and group sync.

deprovision.data_retained: Account is deactivated, not deleted; removing a user from the company does not delete the TeamViewer account.

custom.how: Required extension attribute urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:teamviewer:1.0:SsoUser:ssoCustomerId set to the SSO custom identifier on create.

attributes.notes: Full attribute list is only shown in screenshots in the guides.

limitations.text: Requires a Tensor licence and a configured SSO domain/custom identifier.
SCIM cannot delete users; Entra's Delete action must be removed from the mapping.
Changing a user's username/email is not supported.
Provisioning fails if the email is already registered to a TeamViewer account outside the company.
Entra provisioning needs Microsoft Entra Premium.

capabilities.notes: PUT /users/{id} accepts an 'active' field, used here for deactivate/reactivate.

endpoints.purpose: Updates a user (incl. active, role assign/unassign)
Remove user from company, or permanently delete with isPermanentDelete
Returns the roles assigned to the user
Adds users to a user group
Removes a user from a user group
Assigns a user role to user accounts
Returns the event logs (audit logs) by filter criteria

audit_log_api.notes: Pricing comparison lists 'Auditability (audit log and API)' among Tensor features.

rate_limits.text: Web API rate limits per 24h depend on the licence (comparison table shows e.g. 14,400 and 36,000 requests per 24h).

okta.notes: OIN page markup marks SAML, SWA, SCIM, Create, Update and Deactivate as checked.

google.notes: TeamViewer documents Google Workspace for SSO only.

onelogin.notes: TeamViewer documents OneLogin for SSO only; no SCIM guide. OneLogin connector page not loaded.

fallbacks.other_sync: AD Connector (manual Active Directory sync) listed in the pricing comparison

conflicts.text: Okta SCIM guide says admins can create, update and delete users from Okta; the Entra guide says the SCIM API can't delete users.

open_questions: Whether a deactivated SCIM user frees a licensed-user seat is not documented.
SCIM token expiry, filtering, pagination and rate limits are not documented.
No published SCIM API reference (ServiceProviderConfig, Schemas) was found.
Which Web API rate limit applies to which licence is not clear from the comparison table text.
The AD Connector row in the comparison table could not be tied to a specific licence.
